thread:
Maya: Quick idea — tiny sticker + sticky-note swap to say thanks to folks who helped yesterday? Thinking a few handwritten notes for Devon (UX), Sofia (runtime swap), Kai (late-night deploy) and Alex from oncall. I can drop a stack of stickers and some sticky pads in the kitchen box. :sparkles:
Devon: love it. count me in. also big thanks to @Ivy for the analytics wiring — huge help :raised_hands:
Sofia: Aww thanks! Pairing was super smooth. i'll add a quick blurb to the appreciation doc so it's persisted.
Kai: i will gladly source stickers. or we can do bagels instead — bagel vote? :bagel: (1 for bagels, 0 for stickers)
Ivy: happy to be included. shout to Alex who rescued the database migration at 2am — absolute legend :medal_sports:
Alex: hehe thanks! was a team effort. if there are sticky notes i'll write a ridiculously sincere haiku for whoever wants one.
OpsBot: FYI — kitchen stock low on plain bagels and coffee — if folks go bagels route consider contributing to the coffee fund :coffee: (automated note)
Maya: ok plan: stickers + sticky notes as default; bagels if a few people chime in to cover coffee. i'll start a tiny poll tomorrow morning and put the sticker pack in the box tonight. thanks everyone for the rescue and for pairing — small gestures go a long way :heart:
